content: ग्रन्थः [ग्रन्थ् संदर्भे भावे घञ्] .²1 Binding, stringing together (<ab>fig.</ab> also). .²2 A work, treatise, composition, literary production, book; ग्रन्थारम्भे, ग्रन्थकृत्, ग्रन्थसमाप्ति <ab>&c.</ab> .²3 Wealth, property. .²4 A verse consisting of 32 syllables, written in the Anuṣṭubh metre.
